rationale: This is a focused Python wrapper (148 LOC) around 21 JS evasion scripts ported from puppeteer-extra-plugin-stealth. The core stealth logic lives in the JS evasion modules (utils.js 508 LOC, 20+ evasion scripts covering webdriver, chrome.*, navigator.*, webgl, plugins, mimeTypes, languages, platform, hardwareConcurrency, outer dimensions, hairline, media codecs). The Python layer is thin (StealthConfig dataclass + sync/async entrypoints). Test coverage is minimal (single test for navigator.webdriver). No architecture/design docs exist beyond a brief README. Relevance to Veridian is high for the 'stealth' pipeline concern — it provides a ready-to-use Playwright stealth layer for laptop spec scraping. Tier B because: ~650 LOC total source, solid evasion breadth (18+ fingerprints), proven puppeteer heritage, but limited tests, no architecture docs, and single-maintainer project with GPL-3.0 license.
limitations: Only 1 test file with 1 test case (navigator.webdriver)
